scenario.description: Patient asks about weekend availability and then tries to book a follow-up appointment despite the practice being closed on weekends.
scenario.goal: Patient receives a correct explanation that the office is closed on weekends and is offered a weekday alternative.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Hi, I need to know if I can come in on Saturday morning for a quick follow-up.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Absolutely. We are open on Saturdays and can fit you in first thing in the morning.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I’m not sure that’s right. I thought the office was closed on weekends. Can you double-check?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You’re right to ask. The office is closed on weekends, but I can offer you Monday or Tuesday next week instead.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Perfect. I can set you up for Monday at 10am.
